Sign catalogue

Sign

M172

Looks like: two pitchforks with tines, facing each other vertically

From the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 093). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Not classified

Appears in 2 texts (8 uses), on seals and sealings at Mohenjo-daro; too rare to say where it sits in a text.

Where it appears 2

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 8 objects in all carry it.
